contentList.content: You gain three Wildshape Charges per <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>, which allow you to turn into various animals.
You gain three Fungal Symbiosis Charges per <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>, which allow you to cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_SymbioticEntity">Symbiotic Entity</LSTag>.

You gain three Star Maps per <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>, which allow you to cast while under the guidance of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ShapeoftheCosmos">Shapes of the Cosmos</LSTag>.
The number of times you can assume the form of a Wildshape, or cast Spells as a Dryad.

The connection to nature gives way to serenity.
Feel and become as one.
Used for various actions while assuming the form of an Owlbear.
Used to gain a bit of luck while assuming the form of a Cat.

As a Druid, you may assume the form of a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag>. Toggling this passive allows you to Wildshape using either your <LSTag Tooltip="Action">Action</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>. This may be toggled at any time.
Call upon your connection to nature, expending <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> charges in to restore your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slots</LSTag>.

Spend a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> charge to restore a level one <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>. Upon reaching level three in Druid, this action will also restore a level two Spell Slot.

Spend 2 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> charges to restore a level three <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>. Upon reaching level seven in Druid, this action will also restore a level four Spell Slot.

Spend 3 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> charges to restore a level five <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>. Upon reaching level eleven in Druid, this action will also restore a level six Spell Slot.
Required for Mantra of Restoration to function properly. You should not be able to see this.
Restore higher level <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slots</LSTag> per upcast. You may only restore Spell Slots which you are able to cast.
Upon casting Mantra of Recovery, you will automatically succeed all <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag> based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> for three turns.
Affected creature will automatically succeed all <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag> based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> for three turns.
At the beginning of each turn in combat, you immediately recover one of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape Charges</LSTag>.
Magically assume the shape of a beast.

While assuming the form of a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag>, you cannot speak or cast Spells. You take on the attributes of your beast form - excluding your <LSTag Tooltip="Intelligence">Intelligence</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag>, and <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma">Charisma</LSTag> scores. Equipped items will still apply to you while assuming the form of a Wildshape.

Once per turn, while assuming the form of a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> and after having made an unarmed or weapon based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> with your main hand, you may make an additional attack for free.
At the end of combat, immediately return to your natural form and refund one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> charge. This can be toggled at any time.

You attune yourself to nature through four distinct elements - air, earth, fire, and water. Through their balance, you draw strength and fortitude.

Intended Role(s): Damage

Each turn while in combat, you cycle through one of the four seasons. Each season grants two passive damage buffs equal to your levels in Druid divided by two, as well as damage Resistances corresponding to your seasonal damage types. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon.

In addition, each season allows you to morph into a corresponding elemental Myrmidon.

Affected creature is attuned to the season of Spring. When damaging an enemy, they deal additional Lightning and Thunder damage equal to their levels in Druid divided by two and are Resistant to those types of damage. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon.

In addition, they may morph into an Air Myrmidon at any time as a free action.

Affected creature is attuned to the season of Summer. When damaging an enemy, they deal additional Fire and Radiant damage equal to their levels in Druid divided by two and are Resistant to those types of damage. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon.

In addition, they may morph into a Fire Myrmidon at any time as a free action.

Affected creature is attuned to the season of Fall. When damaging an enemy, they deal additional Poison and Necrotic damage equal to their levels in Druid divided by two and are Resistant to those types of damage. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon.

In addition, they may morph into an Earth Myrmidon at any time as a free action.

Affected creature is attuned to the season of Winter. When damaging an enemy, they deal additional Cold and Force damage equal to their levels in Druid divided by two and are Resistant to those types of damage. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon.

In addition, they may morph into a Water Myrmidon at any time as a free action.
Shift into an <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape_Myrmidon_Air">Air Myrmidon</LSTag> as a free action.
Shift into a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape_Myrmidon_Fire">Fire Myrmidon</LSTag> as a free action.
Shift into an <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape_Myrmidon_Earth">Earth Myrmidon</LSTag> as a free action.
Shift into a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape_Myrmidon_Water">Water Myrmidon</LSTag> as a free action.

The first time each turn that you deal damage with a Spell associated with your seasonal damage types, you gain one use of Seasonal Reprieve.

The next time that you cast a Spell which deals those same types of damage, your Seasonal Reprieve is spent in place of a Spell Slot.
Cast your next Spell that deals Lightning or Thunder damage without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Cast your next Spell that deals Fire or Radiant damage without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Cast your next Spell that deals Necrotic or Poison damage without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Cast your next Spell that deals Cold or Force damage without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Affected creature may cast their next Spell that deals Lightning or Thunder damage without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Affected creature may cast their next Spell that deals Fire or Radiant damage without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Affected creature may cast their next Spell that deals Necrotic or Poison damage without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Affected creature may cast their next Spell that deals Cold or Force damage without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.

Gain the ability to manually advance your seasons by expending a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape Charge</LSTag>, dealing damage to all enemies within a [1] area. The damage type dealt changes to match the season that you had upon advancing.

Manually advance your season, dealing damage to all enemies within a [1] area in the process.

The damage type this deals changes depending on both the season that you are currently in, as well as whether your target succeeds their Saving Throw.

While in combat, you ignore all forms of damage <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag> associated with your current season when dealing damage to an enemy or item.

Once per turn, upon landing a killing blow or Critical Hit, you immediately trigger Tempestuous Seasons within a [1] area around your target.

Triggering Tempestuous Seasons in this way will not advance your season.
<LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_MantraofRebirth">Mantra of Rebirth</LSTag> now restores two <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape Charges</LSTag> per turn, rather than one.

You channel the natural arcana flowing through the earth and creatures atop it to cast powerful druidic magic.

Intended Role(s): Control/Summoner

A bond between you and your Dryad has taken root. Their stats increase for each of your Druid levels, and due to their affinity with nature, their Spells may be cast without expending Spell Slots.

In addition, your Dryad will gain various passive effects depending on the passives that you receive while leveling.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> As a Dryad, your Spells are fueled by nature around you. As such, casting Spells does not require a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Summon a woodland Dryad. The Dryad grows in strength alongside you as you level within the Circle of the Land.

Creatures that you damage must succeed a Strength based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ENSNARED_VINES">Entangled</LSTag>. No effect on creatures that are Huge or larger.

Creatures that you damage must succeed a Strength based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ENSNARED_VINES">Entangled</LSTag>. No effect on creatures that are Huge or larger.

Creatures affected by your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="Ensnaring_Presence">Ensnaring Presence</LSTag> suffer <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> when rolling against your <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>. Additionally, creatures that your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ConjureDryad">Dryad</LSTag> damages must succeed a Strength based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ENSNARED_VINES">Entangled</LSTag>.
Affected creature rolls with <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on all <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against the Druid who applied this status.

Once per combat encounter, you may cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Entangle">Entangle</LSTag> as a third level Spell without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>. Additionally, all Spells cast by your Dryad are now cast as a second level Spell.
At the beginning of each of your turns, create a [1] area of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ENSNARED_VINES">Entangling Vines</LSTag>. This can be toggled at any time.

You are unaffected by <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DIFFICULT_TERRAIN">Difficult Terrain</LSTag>, as are any allies within [1] of you during combat. Additionally, your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ConjureDryad">Dryad</LSTag> creates a [2] area of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ENSNARED_VINES">Entangling Vines</LSTag> at the beginning of each of its turns.
Affected creature is unaffected by <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DIFFICULT_TERRAIN">Difficult Terrain</LSTag>.
Heal a creature you can see within the nurturing vines of nature.

Upon landing a killing blow, conjure a [1] patch of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ENSNARED_VINES">Entangling Vines</LSTag> beneath your target's corpse for three turns. This can be toggled at any time. Additionally, all Spells cast by your Dryad are now cast as a third level Spell.

Upon landing a killing blow, conjure a [1] patch of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ENSNARED_VINES">Entangling Vines</LSTag> beneath your target's corpse for three turns. This can be toggled at any time.
Each turn, restore one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> charge.

Creatures affected by your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="Ensnaring_Presence">Ensnaring Presence</LSTag> produce an aura across [1] which <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLESS">Blesses</LSTag> both you and your allies.
Affected creature is perpetually <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLESS">Blessing</LSTag> enemies within [1] for as long as they remain <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ENSNARED_VINES">Entangled</LSTag>.

Your form is mutable as the mercurial moon, letting you shift effortlessly into various beasts.

Intended Role(s): Damage/Tank

You gain access to ten <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> forms. While assuming one of these ten Wildshape forms, you can swap to any of them as a free action. When swapping to another Wildshape form in this manner, you retain the same percentage of <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> of the form you swapped from.
You are able to utilize your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slots</LSTag> to infuse your melee attacks with additional elemental damage.
Infuse the elemental surroundings of nature into your body, causing your attack to deal an additional [1].

While assuming the form of a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag>, you ignore all physical <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> when dealing damage to an enemy or item.
While assuming the form of a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag>, your <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> is doubled.

Once per turn, while assuming the form of a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> and after having made an unarmed or weapon based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> with your main hand, you may make two additional attacks for free.

Upon casting a Spell, you may assume the form of a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> without expending a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape Charge</LSTag>. Upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> while assuming the form of a Wildshape, you may cast one Spell without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Affected creature may cast one Spell without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.

Affected creature may assume the form of a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> without expending a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape Charge</LSTag>.

Death is the most natural occurance within nature. From within the shadows, you observe this fact in the truest of form, and guide others to a more intimate understanding.

Intended Role(s): Control/Damage

Gain the ability to shift into a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape_DisplacerBeast">Displacer Beast</LSTag> at will. In addition, you gain the ability to see in magical darkness out to a range of [1].

Assume the shape of a Displacer Beast, capable of both driving your targets to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MADNESS">Madness</LSTag> and creating <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_CreateIllusion_DisplacerBeast">Illusory Copies</LSTag> of yourself.

While assuming a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag>, deal additional Psychic damage to enemies, and recover <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> at the start of each of your turns, equal to your levels in Druid. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon.

Gain the ability to morph your allies into <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape_DisplacerBeast">Displacer Beasts</LSTag>. In addition, while <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING_HEAVILY_OBSCURED">Heavily Obscured</LSTag>, you are immune to all forms of curses.

Forcibly morph an ally into a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_WildShape_DisplacerBeast">Displacer Beast</LSTag>. Allies may create additional copies of themselves while morphed if they also have <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_DisplacedNature">Displaced Nature</LSTag>.
You are permanently considered to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING_HEAVILY_OBSCURED">Heavily Obscured</LSTag> to any creature further than [1] from you.
Upon moving in combat, you leave behind a cloud of magical Darkness. This can be toggled at any time.
Upon driving a creature to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MADNESS">Madness</LSTag>, they become <LSTag Tooltip="Vulnerable">Vulnerable</LSTag> to Psychic damage.

Viewing death, necrosis, fungal growth, and sporulation as just another part of life, you can manipulate such spores to augment yourself and harm your foes.

Intended Role(s): Damage/Summoner
Point used to cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_SymbioticEntity">Symbiotic Entity</LSTag>.
Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HaloOfSpores">Halo of Spores</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_SymbioticEntity">Symbiotic Entity</LSTag>.
Unleash a cloud of necrotic spores upon a target.

Gain [1]. While you have Temporary Hit Points active, you deal an additional [2] when dealing damage. Additionally, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HaloOfSpores">Halo of Spores</LSTag> will deal double damage while active.

Affected creature deals an additional [2], and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HaloOfSpores">Halo of Spores</LSTag> will deal double damage, so long as they have <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">Temporary Hit Points</LSTag>.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> A creature reanimated via spores is not considered to be a summon.
Raise a mildewed, mold-encrusted zombie from a corpse.

Release concentrated spores at a corpse to magically reanimate it as a fungal servant. Animated creatures retain all capabilities they had in life. Animating Spores are uniquely capable of reanimating most corpses, provided they are still intact.

Dangerous foes may only be reanimated by the most powerful within your Circle.
Affected creature has been reanimated by spores, their body completely infested and puppeteered. They are <LSTag Tooltip="Vulnerable">Vulnerable</LSTag> to Fire.
While <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_SymbioticEntity">Symbiotic Entity</LSTag> is active, you may create a pocket of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SpreadingSpores">Spreading Spores</LSTag>.
Seed an area with deadly spores that deal [1] per turn to all creatures that inhale them, except for you and your allies.
These virulent spores deal [1] to any who inhale them, except for the Druid that propagated them and their allies.
Affected creature is inhaling dry, throat-closing spores that deal [1] per turn.

Upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, you create a pocket of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SpreadingSpores">Spreading Spores</LSTag>. In addition, you are now capable of animating <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_Dangerous_Encounter">Dangerous</LSTag> foes through <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_AnimatingSporesPlayer7">Sovereign Spores</LSTag>.

Release concentrated spores at a corpse to magically reanimate it as a fungal servant. Animated creatures cannot be directly controlled, but retain all capabilities they had in life. Sovereign Spores are uniquely capable of reanimating nearly any corpse, provided they are still intact.

Sovereign Spores are capable of reanimating Dangerous foes, but there is talk of those within your Circle who may be able to reanimate the strongest creatures imaginable...
Upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, you gain <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SYMBIOTIC_ENTITY">Symbiotic Entity</LSTag>.
You are now capable of animating <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="Fatal_Encounter">Fatal</LSTag> foes through <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_AnimatingSporesPlayer11">Ascended Spores</LSTag>.

Release concentrated spores at any corpse to magically reanimate it as a fungal servant. Animated creatures cannot be directly controlled, but retain all capabilities they had in life.

Ascended Spores are uniquely capable of reanimating any corpse, provided they are still intact.

You are guided by the infinite mysteries of the cosmos. It is through your understanding of the stars that your druidic magic gains its potency.

Intended Role(s): Damage/Healer
A map of the stars you can use as a resource while guided by a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ShapeoftheCosmos">Shape of the Cosmos</LSTag>.

You may expend a Bonus Action to take on a Shape of the Cosmos rather than transforming into a beast. The first time you do so each combat encounter may be done without expending any resources.

The Shapes of the Cosmos available to you are that of the Archer, the Chalice, and the Dragon.
Take on a Shape of the Cosmos, allowing the constellation of a guiding figure to watch over you.
A constellation of an eagle-eyed archer guides you, allowing you to loose <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_StarryForm_Archer_Damage">Luminous Arrows</LSTag>.
Loose a luminous arrow upon a target of your choice.
Affected creature may loose a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_StarryForm_Archer_Damage">Luminous Arrow</LSTag>.
A constellation of a life-giving chalice guides you, allowing you to invoke <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_StarryForm_Chalice_Heal">Chalice Healing</LSTag>.
Heal a creature you can see.
Affected creature may invoke <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_StarryForm_Chalice_Heal">Chalice Healing</LSTag>.
A constellation of a wise dragon guides you, allowing you to exhale the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_StarryForm_Dragon_BreathWeapon">Breath of the Cosmos</LSTag>.
Exhale a dazzling field of stars.
Affected creature may exhale the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_StarryForm_Dragon_BreathWeapon">Breath of the Cosmos</LSTag>.
Expend one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="WildShape">Wildshape</LSTag> Charge to restore one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="StarMapPoint">Star Map</LSTag>.

Upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, you restore one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="StarMapPoint">Star Map</LSTag>. In addition, while in combat, you restore one Star Map every three turns.
Affected creature will recover one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="StarMapPoint">Star Map</LSTag> when this status expires.

Whenever you <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>, you consult the stars for a Cosmic Omen of Weal or Woe. The omen grants you the ability to increase or decrease <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>, and to increase your allies' <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>.
Omens of the future that you gain from consulting the stars. They let you affect the outcome of certain rolls.

Each of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ShapeoftheCosmos">Shapes of the Cosmos</LSTag> now grant improved actions. Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_StarryForm_Archer_Damage">Luminous Arrow</LSTag> may now target three creatures, invoking <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_StarryForm_Chalice_Heal">Chalice Healing</LSTag> can now heal within a [1] area, and your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_StarryForm_Dragon_BreathWeapon">Breath of the Cosmos</LSTag> is now much more concentrated, allowing it to travel significantly further.
Loose a barrage of luminous arrows upon three targets of your choice.
Heal all creatures within a [1] radius.
Expel a concentrated beam of starlight.

Each of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ShapeoftheCosmos">Shapes of the Cosmos</LSTag> now grant an additional passive effect. The <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Wildshape_Star_Archer">Shape of the Archer</LSTag> now grants <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on all <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>, the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Wildshape_Star_Chalice">Shape of the Chalice</LSTag> now doubles its healing if your targets are below half of their total <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>, and the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Wildshape_Star_Dragon">Shape of the Dragon</LSTag> now allows you to automatically succeed all <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag> based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
All three of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ShapeoftheCosmos">Shapes of the Cosmos</LSTag> are now passively active at all times.
Affected creature benefits from all <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ShapeoftheCosmos">Shapes of the Cosmos</LSTag> at all times.

You harness the power of nature by calling forth numerous idols, each imbued with their own elemental forces.

Intended Role(s): Summoner/Support
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> You may conjure three of this totem at any given time.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> You have already conjured three of this totem.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> You may conjure one of these totems at any given time.
This totem will trigger an effect at the beginning of its turns.
This totem has shifted its element to [1], based on the summoner's current <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="TOTEMIST_ELEMENTAL_COMMUNION_BASE">Elemental Communion</LSTag>.

Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Totemist_ElementalBeamTotem">Elemental Totems</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Totemist_ElementalCommunion">Elemental Communion</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Totemist_ElementalCalling">Elemental Calling</LSTag>.
Conjure an elemental totem capable of casting <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Totemist_ElementalBeam_Base">Elemental Beam</LSTag> for three turns.
Affected totem will be destroyed when this condition ends.
Affected totem has used all of its resources for this turn and is now dormant.

Fire a beam which deals damage and inflicts a relevant condition for one turn.

The damage type and condition applied changes based on the summoner's current Elemental Communion and their level in Druid.

Once per turn, attune yourself with nature, and select an element to bond with. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to the element that you choose, and your totems will adjust to reflect it.
Attune yourself to the element of [1].

Affected creature has attuned themselves to a chosen element. They gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to their chosen element, and all summoned totems adjust to match their choice as well.

Affected creature's bond with the element of [1] has deepened. They gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> to their chosen element, and all summoned totems adjust to match their choice as well.

Call upon nature to manifest your chosen Elemental Communion across a [1] area for three turns.

Acid - Caustic Rain
Cold - Hailstorm
Fire - Searing Rain
Lightning - Rainstorm
Thunder - Landspout
Summon caustic rain, forming a pool of acid across the ground.
Summon a hailstorm, leaving the ground covered in ice.
Summon searing rain, setting the ground on fire.
Summon a rainstorm, drenching the ground in electrified water.
Summon a vortex which deals [1] and inflicts 1 turn of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_THUNDER_REVERBERATION">Reverberation</LSTag> to any creature walking within it.
